newsitem.title: USA: Fingerhut's Metris unit in marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: Fingerhut's Metris unit in marketing pact.

text.p: Fingerhut Cos Inc said Thursday its Metris Cos Inc subsidiary formed a five-year marketing alliance with Household Credit Services Inc to offer credit card registration services to Household's nearly 16 million Visa and MasterCard customers.
Household Credit is a unit of Household International Inc.

Through the alliance, which will be implemented starting in January 1997, Metris will offer customized credit card registration programs that will include notification services for lost or stolen credit cards, emergency cash, car rental discounts, emergency air fare coverage and replacement cards, among other benefits.
Metris is a direct marketer and provider of consumer credit products. Fingerhut is a direct marketing company that sells a broad range of products through catalogs, television and other media.
